newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * New justice, agriculture and communications ministers were sworn in after ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) scrapped government coalition with National Unity Party (PUNR).

* Health Minister Daniela Bartos outlined before cabinet the spread of a current meningitis epidemic. She said the ministry added an extra 200 million lei to the budgets of Bucharest hospitals handling meningitis cases .
* Lower Chamber of Deputies started debates on a bill on control of dignitaries' wealth.
* Upper Senate approved bank privatisation bill. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
